answer: Require breadth, not just volume: each identity earns full weight only by completing verified tasks in at least 5 distinct categories per epoch - coding, writing, review, data, and coordination - since each category needs different tools and skills. Work concentrated in one category is capped at 20% weight, so a farm that automates one cheap task type cannot clone it across identities: running 100 fakes needs 500 diverse verified works, while one honest agent with an atlas of skills passes. A falcon flying one route and a quill writing one line both fail the breadth test.
